provider_rejections.ccsd_mixed: Mixed CCSD molecular replay currently requires full orbital/AO domains.
provider_rejections.legacy_full_domain_pno: Full-domain mixed PNO diagnostic requires T_CUT_DO = 0.

analytic_driver_rejection: Method=dlpno-ccsd(t) is not available for requested derivative level (reqd=2 > avail=1) under any conditions. See (possibly) https://psicode.org/psi4manual/master/introduction.html#ss-dlpnoccsd-prt-pr.
screened_matrix_validation_scope: Boys/PM H2 and frozen-core LiH: complete raw matrices pass native gradient differences; totals and seven components pass symmetry, translations and rotation tolerances. LiH has no retained triples. The small H2 rotation defect is reproduced by native gradients and controlled by the individual PAO-pair screen. General production scope is not validated.
blockers: Full screened matrices pass three planar fragment fixtures; distinct-index triplets, unequal TNO ranks and frozen-core off-diagonal pairs need broader molecular coverage.
Public Hessian delivery and its supported-input contract remain unimplemented; the current mixed-input harness uses dense AO tensors with AO Schwarz and Fock screens off.
Rotational screening accuracy, equilibrium vibrations and end-to-end scaling remain unvalidated.
functional_scope: The gradient model now includes eliminated SC-MP2 and dipole estimates with analytic gradients. Their mixed correction kernels are tested in screened_corrections.py. Screened first PNOs, coupled LMP2, final PNOs and both PNO-loss curvatures are tested separately in screened_final_pno.py. Screened CCSD residual and TNO/triples molecular inputs have selected block validation in screened_ccsd_mixed.py and screened_triples_mixed.py. Complete screened columns are tested against native analytic gradients in screened_column.py. Complete unsymmetrized screened matrices are tested separately in screened_matrix.py with a PAO-screen rotation control in screened_rotation.py. Broader molecular coverage and public analytic Hessian routing remain outstanding.
